files.text: Part 1.1. In this part, you will hear three short questions about yourself and your daily life. After each question, you have five seconds to get ready, and then thirty seconds to answer. Start speaking when you hear this sound.
What do you usually do at the weekend?
What is your favourite food? Why?
Who do you spend the most time with in your family?
